description: Source code for the Dcm module in an AUTOSAR platform, implementing diagnostic communication interface functions, including initialization, buffer management, and protocol handling.

methods.name: Dcm_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Dcm module, setting up configuration and internal state.

methods.name: Dcm_MainFunction
methods.description: Main processing loop for the Dcm module, calling sub-components.

methods.name: Dcm_ProvideRxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a receive buffer for incoming diagnostic messages.

methods.name: Dcm_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a message from the lower layer.

methods.name: Dcm_GetActiveProtocol
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active diagnostic protocol.

methods.name: Dcm_GetSesCtrlType
methods.description: Retrieves the current session control type.

methods.name: Dcm_ProvideTxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a transmit buffer for outgoing diagnostic messages.
